description: Open a 30-minute transactional window for an AI agent against a specific restaurant. Returns an agent_session_id you MUST pass to every downstream order tool (place_order, cancel_order, request_bill, waiter_call, apply_promo). Also returns the customer-facing confirmation URL — share it with the human so they can review the cart before checkout.

restaurant_id.description: Canonical restaurant id from get_restaurant or search_products.

name: start_order_session
title: Start an order session
